continuity: Replace each phrase at the next group start with no blank interval. During pauses hold the current phrase and neutralize word highlight; highlight one aligned spoken word at a time.

explicit_exceptions: Opening 181 phrase is creator transcript as spoken words; width-fit longer phrases retained when needed for syntax.
for those who could no longer help themselves.
of mutual help / as it would be to see nothing but cruelty.
